The '''Vinth system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared a name with the [[Vinth Conflict]], which occurred on the planet [[Gerhalt III]]<ref name="US">{{GamerCite|2|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Duros}}</ref> in the [[Altier sector/Legends|Altier sector]].<ref name="EAOCG">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Gerhalt system/Legends|Gerhalt system]]</ref>
